quest.title: Traces of Chroma
quest.description: One day, by chance, we become the assistants of a famous designer.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Easybreeze Badge x1

dialogues.text: Hmm, this is stunning work... The brushstrokes are delicate, the colors bold — you've got some real artistic flair!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, you've got good taste in art!
It's too bad, though... I heard the people on this street hired a scary guard to catch any troublemakers who go around painting on the walls.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? A guard? Paimon didn't notice any big, scary guards!
Indeed. His name's Cozatl, I think. He looks totally normal. In fact... he looks just like me...

choices.text: Ahem... Paimon, doodling on walls isn't exactly upstanding behavior.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: S—Sorry... Hey, wait! You were doing it too!
It's fine, really! I've always thought the people around here were way too uptight anyway. This is Natlan — what kind of wall doesn't have a little graffiti on it?
Besides, as long as I clean it up before anyone sees, it'll be like it never happened!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe... Mr. Cozatl, you're the best!
*sigh* Well, your worries are gone... but mine are still...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's bothering you?
It's about this childhood friend of mine. Bit of an airhead — always drifting around like a Flowcurrent Bird. Everyone calls him "Lil' Floaty."
He's always loved drawing and painting, and he's actually picked up some real skills. Says he's carrying on the legacy of our old teacher, Alu. Nowadays, he's known as the face of "Chromaflair."
In the past, "Chromaflair" was famous in Natlan for its amazing use of color and texture. So yeah, he's kind of a big deal now.

It just so happens that the Easybreeze Holiday Resort needs someone to help with their facade design, so they invited a group of designers under the guise of a bidding competition. And guess who's on the list?

I figured I'd ask him to help some of the neighborhood shops design their storefronts as well, but he said his schedule's packed to the brim. He told me he couldn't take on any more work unless he had two assistants.
*sigh* If only there were two talented and reliable adventurers around here with a bit of artistic sense...
After all, he's a super famous designer, and he's always been a very generous, free-spirited person — I can't imagine him giving his assistants anything less than an impressive reward...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! That sounds like a reward fit for our Mora pouches! Hehe, we're in!

choices.text: Paimon, you're so easy to convince.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't say that! Helping people in need is an adventurer's duty too!
Great, it's settled then. I'll give Zolin — that's the guy — a heads-up. Just meet him at the cafe across the street later.
Oh, and since it's a bidding competition, you might find some rivals who'll play dirty. Watch your backs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pfft! We've dealt with way worse than a bunch of crooked bidders!
That's reassuring. As for the graffiti, don't sweat it, I'll clean it up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay! And leave your Lil' Floaty guy to us!
#Of course. It shouldn't be a challenge for the legendary {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you recognized us from the start!

choices.text: You figured out Paimon's weakness so fast.
Sorry about this. We'll clean it up right away.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: I won't lie — I still don't really get what's going on. But I trust the old man. He'd never steal anything, especially not from the Asha.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: I'll stay here and keep Alvo in check, make sure he doesn't get in your way. The rest of the truth... I'm counting on you to uncover it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No worries.
If you want to read the notes again, just come look for me whenever.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Well, well! I never expected the famed face of "Chromaflair" to be so young. Definitely worth the long trip out here!

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: I've heard your school puts a special focus on color — makes it feel like the hues are actually flowing. Any chance I'll get to witness that for myself today?

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: I wouldn't say we're experts, really. At "Chromaflair," we simply have our own interpretation of how to bring out the textures of colors. It's a little different from how others do it, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: What a coincidence! We at "The Varikas" also have insights of our own when it comes to color. I hope you'll be willing to share some of your tips during the bid later.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Color is the art of clash and contrast. "Sharing tips" would be inappropriate. We should have a friendly clash — a spar — instead.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Hey there, my bad! I got held up by a little something and couldn't get here on time. Hope I didn't keep you waiting too long, pals!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Oho? Hey hey hey — Lil' Floaty, it's really you! So you did become a designer! I thought Cozatl was just pulling my leg again!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Eh? Big Sis...?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: "Color is the art of clash and contrast" — isn't that what the old man always says? Hehe, you're starting to sound like a real designer already.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: B—Big Sis, you didn't need to say that out loud...

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Ah, so that line came from the founder of "Chromaflair" himself. No wonder it carries such gravitas.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Heh, Mr. Lil' Floaty, huh? I wonder if your skills can live up to Mr. Alu's legacy.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Alright, Lil' Floaty, go ahead and use my cafe as your canvas. Show them what "Chromaflair" is all about!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Sure, I can do that... Just give me a moment. Cozatl promised me two assistants, but I haven't met them yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Paimon supposes this is where we come in!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem, Zolin, your assistants have arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: #Wha— wait, you're... {NICKNAME} and Paimon?! Since when could Cozatl call in favors like that?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Oho... the legendary adventurers. Hmph, even with top-tier assistants, the result's still going to depend on the designer's skill.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Fine. I'll give you a proper taste of what "Chromaflair" can do.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Under Zolin's direction, you quickly complete the preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: #Ahem. {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, please take these pigments.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, the colors are so weird! Are you sure they actually work?

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Ahem! Of course they work, and I'll have you know they're very useful! That's what being a color master is all about — turning the odd and ordinary into something brilliant! It's about drawing out the best colors in the most unexpected ways!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, really? You're not just pretending to understand, are you...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, alright then! Shall Paimon begin coloring the wall as our color master commands?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon doesn't either. But anyway, we'll just go with what Zolin says and splash some color on!

dialogues.text: Whoa, that's so cool! Try spraying another!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Honestly, I don't get why Zolton's so attached to you.
I guess it's just natural charm. Huh, looks like you even made some little accessories for it. You really care about Zolton, don't you?
#Wait, don't tell me you saw the famous {NICKNAME} with their adorable pet and thought, "Hey, I want one too"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey! Paimon's no pet! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are best buddies!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: That's right! Just like Zolton and I — we're the best of friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, so the little one's name is Zolton? What a cute name! Nice to meet you, Zolton! Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!
Alright, playtime's over. Let's get to work and start painting.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait a minute, that arrogant fellow hasn't shown up yet, has he? Aren't we starting a bit early?
Haven't you noticed the crowd? Everyone's waiting to see your masterpiece. Don't keep your fans waiting, o great designer!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Ahem... Okay, listen up, you two. Today's commission is pretty simple. Just paint the sports supplies and the store sign. Use... the same technique as last time!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: But keep in mind, the surfaces this time are a lot smaller, which makes it trickier to get the colors just right. Prepare yourselves, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But it seems that Asha don't have particularly complex emotions or memories. It's hard to imagine that one Asha alone could create such rich colors...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! It's so shiny and pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: These colors...! The whole wall's rippling like a shimmering stream. I didn't expect to see this kind of vibrance out in a backwater place like this...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Lil' Floaty, you... this is seriously amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Aww, come on, Big Sis, it's not that big a deal...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Ever since the old man passed, I haven't seen color like this again. If he were still around... he'd be so proud of you.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Well, Alvo? Still think "The Varikas" can hold a candle to what you just saw?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Tch... No need for that. I'm backing out. This piece has already blown past every expectation I had. If I show up at the competition, I'll just embarrass myself. So, without further ado, goodbye.
Huh? Alvo's already gone? Aww man, I missed the good part!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Cozatl, you numbskull! Why didn't you tell me the cafe was Big Sis's place?!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Cozatl, you little brat! Where'd you run off to this time? Why do you always show your face only after the dust settles?
Hey hey, chill, Big Sis! Someone picking up the "Chromaflair" mantle — that's big news! Of course I had to let the old man know first, right?
Especially when the one inheriting it is the very person he thought had zero talent with color — the so-called "Cartographer." You bet I rushed over to tell him!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Hey, it's been years! Are you seriously still using that nickname on me?! Don't you ever get tired of it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The "Cartographer"?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Hehe, did you know? When Lil' Floaty was a kid, he used to draw all over the blankets...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Please, Big Sis, I'm begging you... Not this story again!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Oh come on, what's the big deal? Don't you remember that time when you—

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Ahh!!! Look, everyone, I really have to prepare for tomorrow! I'll see you all later! Goodbye!
Hehe, look at that... Our shy, clumsy Lil' Floaty really has grown up, huh, Big Sis?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: He sure has... I can't believe you used the bid as an excuse to bring him back. If the old man were still here, he'd be over the moon.
Of course he had to come back. "Chromaflair" started here — it's only right that it ends here too.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: And there's you... The old man had such high hopes for you. Then you disappeared for years, and never even told me where his grave was.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: And now the prodigal Cozatl returns, only to tell me he's given up on painting. How am I supposed to explain that to him?
C'mon, Big Sis... Painting was just a childhood thing. I was never the patient type anyway, y'know?
Well, I've still got patrol duty to take care of, so I'd better get going.
Oh, right. You two — I need a quick word in private. Let's meet up where we ran into each other earlier, yeah?
Phew, that was close... Is this what getting older feels like? Now that I think about it, the old man was the same, always going around sharing our embarrassing stories...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you had embarrassing moments too?
Of course! Like that nickname, "Cartographer" — the old man loved calling him that more than anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That just sounds like you embarrassing other people!
Hehe, well, that's not the point. The point is... someone just revived the "Chromaflair" style, and in front of Alvo, no less. That could be a problem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Isn't that a good thing?
Well... It's a long story. About ten years ago, an adventure team called "Free Spirits" came to this land.
Only most of the members weren't here to adventure. Big Sis just wanted a getaway, and me and Lil' Floaty had straight-up run away from home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's a bit too free-spirited!
It really was. The only serious adventurer in the group was also the most senior. He was an old man, a priest from the Masters of the Night-Wind.
He was originally trying to uncover some link between Saurian Inscriptions and Asha. But maybe we rubbed off on him... he suddenly dropped that and started researching color theory instead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... don't tell me that old man was...?
That's right. People used to say his colors hit with the force of a hammer, but danced like light on water. That clash of power and shimmer is where "Chroma" comes from.
Ever since he created the style, he was on the lookout for someone to pass it on to. Lil' Floaty and I were young, so naturally he picked us and forced us to call him "Master."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Forced"... Sounds like you were really that unwilling?
Back then, I had no idea we were learning something that would one day take all of Natlan by storm.
In the end, the old man passed without naming a successor. All that's left of him are some old sketches and a few of his pieces.
Since then, a bunch of us tried to recreate what he did — even me. But no one's really succeeded, except maybe Lil' Floaty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon gets that part now. But what's that got to do with things being "a problem"?
Because of people like those merchants from Nod-Krai. They've got ambition, power... and zero hesitation when it comes to playing dirty.
What a headache... If they ever try to get forceful, poor Lil' Floaty might be in real trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No worries there! {NICKNAME} is super strong, so those guys wouldn't stand a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Plus, as righteous adventurers, we don't let the bad guys get away with anything. Right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Well, after everything you just said... How could I refuse?

response.text: You two are lifesavers. How about we meet on the main road at the Easybreeze Market tomorrow? I'll put together a detailed plan too, just in case.

choices.text: Besides, looks like our time as assistants isn't over yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give me a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Got it. Take your time.

talks.objective: Go to the main street in Easybreeze Market

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: So in essence, the "Chromaflair" style was created by the old man and Zolton.
#I see... Now we just need one last decisive piece of evidence. Zolin, since that's the case, why don't you try what {NICKNAME} suggested?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Believe in yourself, Zolin.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: G—Got it. Zolton, my partner... please! I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Zolton sprays some purple graffiti on the blank wall.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's really purple! Amazing, Lil' Floaty! You've achieved what even the old man never could!
Emotions and memories, huh... Haha, old man, guess I never really understood what you were teaching me. Funny, I was even about to...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: It... It actually worked! All those years... You knew, Master? You really believed in me? You were telling me the truth all along... And now... now the colors...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: That's why you made me care for the Asha... why you pushed me to travel and sketch in all sorts of places before... before you passed...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: All of it... everything you did... was to help me find my own path. My own colors, shaped by my own memories and emotions...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: And I... I thought you just didn't believe in me. I thought you saw me as a talentless hack. I thought you made me do all the chores just to be rid of me, because I wasn't worth your time...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: So that's what this was all about, Zolton... That's what you've been trying to tell me all along. And I... I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Master... if I'd only known... I... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: #Bravo, bravo, what a show! Looks like the legendary {NICKNAME} has already made up {M#his}{F#her} mind.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Then I guess it's time for you all to see what "The Varikas" is really capable of!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa! Watch out, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what was the main reason for purple being missing...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh, wait. Now that I think about it, it seems that they do meet the conditions after all...
After all these years, seeing these colors again really brings back a flood of memories...
This combination... wasn't it called "complementary pairing"? I remember one of Master's final works made use of this approach...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Didn't think you'd remember a small detail like that... Though these days, I just call it a "color contrast."

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: After all, as the saying goes, "Color is the art of clash and contrast — a language of raw emotion." Hence the name, "color contrast."

Really? Here I thought you were just thinking of our youth... Y'know, like the one time that little Tatankasaur headbutted you into a bunch of paint buckets, and they got splattered all over the room. Now, that was a real "clash and contrast" of colors...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Hey! You're bringing that up just to embarrass me in front of everyone, aren't you!?

Don't be such a stick in the mud. I'm getting older, and nostalgia's starting to hit really hard these days. The old man was like this too, wasn't he? Always going on and on about the past like it was yesterday...
Forgetting... now there's a fate worse than death. If even we forget that place... who'll remember that the dazzling legacy of "Chroma" began in a pitch-black cave?
A tree that forgets its roots can never bear good fruit. So yeah, I'll bring up the past now and then — to keep it fresh in your mind.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Ugh... Every time you get all cryptic like this, it's never a good sign...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Hold on, where's Alvo? Wasn't he acting all high and mighty before? He didn't even show up...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Don't tell me that cafe showdown spooked him so bad he ran back to Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, someone's confident today!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: #Of course I am! I've got Zolton with me, and the legendary {NICKNAME}, and Paimon to back me up! Our victory is a foregone conclusion!
Good to see you in good spirits, Lil' Floaty. But come on. Do you really think someone from Nod-Krai's gonna play fair?
He could just threaten you outright... or try to bribe me behind your back. It wouldn't be complicated.
Honestly, I wouldn't be surprised if they're already on their way to the old man's grave...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: How's that possible? Only you and I are supposed to know where that cave is!
Yeah, well... that WAS true... unless a certain idiot got followed last time they went there.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: W—Wait... You mean after the bidding yesterday?! Oh no... Then wouldn't the old man's place—
If I know Alvo, he'll probably cut out every bit of wall, floor, and rock in that cave with any trace of pigment on it, and analyze them piece by piece...

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: I won't stand for this! We need to stop him, now!

dialogues.speaker: Messenger
dialogues.text: Cozatl! Alvo really did head that way, and with a whole crew in tow! Big Sis went on ahead, but I'm afraid she won't be able to hold them off for long!
Then what are we waiting for? Let's go, everyone, time to see what Alvo's really up to.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Back off! This is the old man's resting place, and you are not welcome here! I'm warning you, Alvo, don't think you have the right to barge in just because numbers are on your side.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: That's funny, Ms. Cafe Owner. You just found out about this place yourself, and now you're already keeping everyone else from getting their fingers in the pie?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: #And what do we have here? The great Zolin, and even the legendary {NICKNAME}? What eminent company we have today... I don't suppose this means there's some sort of priceless secret hidden around here, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: You scoundrel! Instead of bidding properly, you snuck off and came here. What's the big idea?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Well, see, even if "The Varikas" were to take something by force, we would do so openly. We wouldn't stoop so low as to use sneaky tricks... Tch, it's disgraceful, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: What are you trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Ladies and gentlemen, behold — these flowing, radiant hues. You've surely realized it by now. Yes, this is what they call a "Chroma" masterpiece.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: What a pity. Such colors, left to wither under wind and sun, unknown to all of Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Luckily, our dear Mr. Lil' Floaty here inherited this style, and has recently started to make waves.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Y—You! Stop beating around the bush! You wanna say something, spit it out!

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Over a decade has passed, yet this mural has no cracks nor signs of fading. It still shines as brightly as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: That's thanks to some recent restoration. Judging by the marks, it was done just a few days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: But these paint marks don't look like they were done by hand. They were sprayed on — almost as if... an Asha did it?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Care to explain these "restorations," Mr. Zolin? Why don't you tell us who did this?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: And do please enlighten us, because now, my curiosity is well and truly piqued... who exactly is the real master of "Chromaflair"?
You seem awfully confident in your theory, Alvo.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Of course. I took some paint from here yesterday and had it analyzed by experts.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Which revealed that these pigments contain extraordinarily pure, volatile Phlogiston. Almost as though they're alive...

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: More precisely, these pigments weren't made by humans. They were created by a Phlogiston-rich lifeform.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: In other words, this paint is the work of an Asha, a living being made of pure Phlogiston. No wonder its colors put to shame anything humans can make.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: And look who we have here! Zolin's ever-present Asha companion. Quite the coincidence, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Face it, everyone! The "Chromaflair" was never about human artistry. Just two generations of con artists taking credit for an Asha's natural talents!
Oh, but there's more. Zolin's colors have never gone beyond the old man's palette. They both never used purple.
And the Asha with them? It's been the same one all these years.
*sigh* Lil' Floaty, now it makes sense why Zolton took to me so quickly...
So the truth is that this story isn't about a prodigy designer returning home after studying across Natlan...
...But instead, about a pitiful orphan. An orphan who, upon stumbling upon an Asha in the wild, his childhood teacher's companion, gave in to malice and started stealing the fruits of others' labor.
And that "venerated master"? Nothing but a clever fraud who fooled an entire generation!
The evidence is on my side, Zolin, and I'm not even done going through all of it. But honestly? The look on your face is all the proof we need.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Cozatl... you set me up...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Lil' Floaty... look at me. Tell me this isn't true.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two are champions of justice. I'm sure you won't shield this petty criminal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zolton, are you trying to say something...?

response.speaker: Alvo
response.text: ...Fine. Since you insist, I won't argue. Investigate all you want. Just don't disgrace yourself in the process.

choices.text: I don't agree with your conclusion.

talks.objective: Talk to Cozatl and investigate the cavern

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: A—Argh...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Hey, you two. Seriously, thank you. Without your help, I can't even begin to imagine how this would've played out.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: As for Alvo... I'll get someone from the resort to deal with him. And these two little rascals...
Two days, Big Sis. Just give us two days — we'll definitely make things right by then... Please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright. Two days it is.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: #Very well. If {NICKNAME} says so, I'll go along with it. You two better not let me down. I'll be watching and waiting!
I already cleared out this cave after the old man passed. Aside from these notes, there shouldn't be anything of value left.
But if you've still got questions... take the notes. Maybe you'll reach a different conclusion than I did.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So in essence, "Chroma" was a collaboration between Alu and Zolton.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Well... Umm... H—Have you decided on the color scheme yet?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That name... It's cute... but not cute-cute, y'know?

response.speaker: Tochtli
response.text: It's my cafe! And let me tell you, this will become the resort's absolute best cafe in the near future. What do you think? Looks wonderful, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Tochtli
response.text: Aside from the cafe's decor, name, equipment, and all that other nonsense, I've already got everything else covered! We're ready for anything!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ready for anything... with nothing prepared?

response.speaker: Tochtli
response.text: Don't you sweat the details, we'll build that bridge when we get to it! Just come back to me once business is booming, and I'll give you a discount.

response.speaker: Tochtli
response.text: Same to you!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Now, let's welcome our star designer, Zolton, to add the final splash of color to the Chromaflair Studio!
You know, once Lil' Floaty admitted that Zolton was the real designer, he seems... more relaxed, somehow.
And he said he'd "work on his linework and grow into a good assistant"... What a simple and straightforward guy...
By the way, I really have to thank you two. Without your help, I don't think either of us would've found our way back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, exactly! Helping people find their way is what great adventurers do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But hey, Cozatl. You still have some explaining to do, don't you?
Haha, I knew that question was coming. I was kinda hoping you'd be too busy to bring it up...
As you've probably guessed, I used the pretense of a design bid to lure Zolin back. Then I paired him with someone who had... let's say, a pretty shady reputation.
And I invited you as assistants to act as reputable witnesses.
It was all meant to "reveal the truth"... or at least, what I thought was the truth. But all I really ended up revealing was how petty and jealous I've been.
To be honest, I always thought I was more talented than Zolin — or even the old man. So when I couldn't figure something out, I just assumed they must've cheated somehow.
Anyway... in the past, traitors were exiled as punishment. I guess that's the path I should take too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cozatl...
Well, time for me to begin my exile. Thank you, both of you. You've helped me see a lot more clearly. I suppose this is goodbye.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Cozatl turns and leaves, without looking back.

response.speaker: Zolin
response.text: #Umm... Excuse me, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Zolton would love for you to help with the studio's finishing touches, if you'd be be willing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Let's get painting!

choices.text: Looks like the assistant job's not over just yet.
This whole thing... you set it up, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Wow, that's some solid work! No wonder the great designer Zolton had its eye on you. Oh, right, Lil' Floaty, didn't you have something you wanted to say?

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Thank you for stepping in. You didn't just help us get to the truth — you gave me the chance to make things right.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Aside from your payment as our assistant, we'd like to officially invite you to be a guest designer for the studio. From now on, the exterior walls are yours to paint as you please.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Same goes for my cafe! Go wild with your designs, and don't you dare hold back!
No vandalization...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Hold on, hold on! The wall's not fully prepped yet. No painting for now, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Well? Have you made up your mind, great adventurers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still need a little more time...

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Very well, but remember — time waits for no one.

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Well? Have you made up your mind, great adventurers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we're good to go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep.
Alright, I've got the notes right here. Please take a look.
What's wrong? Want to read the old man's notes again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: No color at all? ...Ah, I get it. A blank canvas. A fresh start. You're telling me to begin again, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Pfft, don't read too much into it, Lil' Floaty — they probably just ran out of ideas. Anyway, didn't you have something you wanted to say?

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Thank you for stepping in. You didn't just help us get to the truth — you gave me the chance to make things right.

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Aside from your payment as our assistant, we'd like to officially invite you to be a guest designer for the studio. From now on, the exterior walls are yours to paint as you please.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Same goes for my cafe! Go wild with your designs, and don't you dare hold back!

dialogues.speaker: Zolin
dialogues.text: Zolton, I—I...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, it's you! Well, how did it go? Did Lil' Floaty give you any trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm still working on it...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That's alright, take your time! If Lil' Floaty holds you back, just let me know and I'll take care of him!

dialogues.speaker: Alvo
dialogues.text: Phew, it's so hot... This backwater is such a pain...
Looks like a lot of people came! I guess now "Chromaflair" is finally getting the recognition it deserves! All the effort I put into arranging this auction has paid off...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't look very happy.
Not happy? I'm over the moon! I'm just feeling a little tired... After all, in order to make this happen, I haven't slept in days.
I should get some rest. I'll leave you to take care of Lil' Floaty.
